title: Add integration tests driving ScheduleSupervisor.tick() with SLA monitor
description:
Fix blocking finding #2: Missing integration test driving supervisor's real tick() with monitor over fixture ledger.

Files to modify:
- tests/unit/test_schedule_supervisor.py

Implementation details:
1. Create a fixture ledger with SLA contract violations (work ledger entries, audit chain entries, lineage spine, spend ledger)
2. Construct a ScheduleSupervisor with a real SLAMonitor using build_monitor_from_sdd on a temp .sdd dir
3. Call tick() and verify signed breach receipts are produced
4. Call tick() again with unchanged state and verify no duplicate receipts (tests deduplication)
5. Test tick() without contracts skips evaluation

Tests to implement (from issue):
- test_breached_contract_produces_signed_receipt_within_one_tick
- test_ongoing_breach_does_not_reemit_every_tick
- test_tick_without_contracts_skips_evaluation

Need to set up:
- Temp .sdd directory with SLA store containing a contract
- Work ledger with duration/frequency violations
- Audit chain entries
- Lineage spine for freshness
- Spend ledger for spend rate
- SLA signing identity

Acceptance criteria: All three tests pass and verify the real tick() path with SLA monitor.
